entries.what: The Get Users Follows endpoint, GET /helix/users/follows, is removed.

source.quote: The Get Users Follows API endpoint has been removed.

requires: Get Channel Followers needs a user access token with the moderator:read:followers scope, and the user must be the broadcaster or a moderator of it, to return who follows. An app access token no longer works for this.
Its response has total and data with user_id and followed_at, not the old from_id and to_id.

entries.what: Version 1 of the channel.follow EventSub subscription type is removed. Only version 2 is listed. The version is a separate value, often set on another line, so a hit on the type name needs reading: version 2 of the same name is live.

source.quote: V1 of channel.follow has been removed.

lookFor: An EventSub subscription of type channel.follow whose version is 1
requires: Version 2 requires the moderator:read:followers scope and a moderator_user_id in the condition, as well as broadcaster_user_id.
